value.rationale: Reznick establishes eventual modular coverage but leaves finite onset undetermined. The exact first-covering depths, unique penultimate missing residue, and least first-arrival indices solve the natural minimal dyadic tree-depth problem for a complete initial tower of eleven moduli; its endpoint requires enumerating 3,145,728 primitive pairs. Sharp four-step jumps at exponents 6 and 10 rule out naive fixed-increment extrapolation within the certified range. This nontrivial finite cutoff census is useful for future modular Stern mixing/diameter work. No general theorem beyond the finite table is asserted.
